Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
Yes, you can usually speed things up by rescheduling your next delivery to an earlier available date:
Log in to your account
Go to Plan → Your Next Box → Manage Delivery → Reschedule
Pick an earlier date and confirm
Just make sure you do this before your order deadline shown under “Make changes by…”. If you need a special arrangement beyond the available dates, you can contact our Pet Support Team to see if we can help further.
